quality_observations.asr_backcheck_is_necessary_not_sufficien: ASR agreed with perceived correctness on clear wins and losses, but cannot arbitrate prosody or naturalness. Human listening review remains mandatory.
quality_observations.asr_console_artifact: the transcription JSON renders a trailing replacement character for the full stop; a console encoding artefact of the tool output, not an audio defect
quality_observations.loudness: provider output peaked at -0.5 dB and -1.5 dB. No clipping was observed, but headroom is minimal and a loudness normalisation gate is needed before compose.
quality_observations.image_container: output container is chosen by the provider and does not follow the requested extension
quality_observations.video_dimensions_are_approximate: 9:16 requested, 768x1344 delivered, so composition gates must assert tolerance rather than exact ratio
quality_observations.video_audio_is_unrequested: H3 returned an AAC track although no audio was requested, at near-ambient level
quality_observations.cli_silently_drops_unknown_flags: passing --resolution to the official CLI was ignored rather than rejected, which is a hazard for a paid API
quality_observations.generated_media_never_evidence: generated assets in this receipt are capability evidence only and are not admissible as business evidence
